traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria of docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are satisfied: - File-Level Template: ensureFileSupportsAnnotation + buildSupportsTemplateComment + insertSupportsTemplate implement automatic insertion of a file-level @supports JSDoc with a clear placeholder path and REQ IDs when missing, only for identified test files. - Format Fixes: normalizeReqId + normalizeReqPrefixInDescription + handleItOrTestCall implement normalization of malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes (spacing, underscores, parentheses, casing), only when an existing REQ-like identifier is present. - Template Quality: template includes explicit placeholder path (XXX.X-STORY-NAME, REQ-XXX-YYY, REQ-XXX-ZZZ) and a TODO line explaining what to replace, making expectations clear. - Quality/Safety: fixes only affect comments and test name strings; they preserve quote style and avoid altering test bodies. No new requirement IDs or story paths are inferred; auto-fix is skipped when no recognizable REQ prefix exists. - Integration: rule is fixable by ESLint, wired through the plugin, and validated via RuleTester; test run confirms behavior under jest. - User Experience: the placeholder and normalized prefixes are consistent and easy to complete; behavior is predictable and documented. - Error Handling: rule reports issues in all relevant cases but only supplies fixers when a safe, deterministic fix is available (e.g., malformed but recognizable prefix, missing @supports with non-semantic template). - Documentation: user-docs/api-reference.md documents the auto-fix behavior, its purpose for Story 021.0, and the configuration options controlling it.
Given the direct mapping between story requirements (REQ-TEST-FIX-*) and the annotated implementation plus passing, targeted tests, this story is fully implemented and currently passing.
